# Wheelhouser LLC

> Wheelhouser LLC is a privacy-first native software engineering studio—built with zero tracking, zero customer data use or sales, and zero ads—building the flagship Marquee-Magic digital signage ecosystem, a sovereign Cross-Platform Core Workstation Suite (Web Browser, File Browser, Text Editor, Terminal), and bespoke Custom Cross-Platform Desktop Applications across Windows 10/11, macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), and Enterprise Linux (Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44/45, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS).

- Website: https://wheelhouser.com/
- Custom Desktop App Engineering Services: https://wheelhouser.com/services.html
- Founder & Principal Architect Executive CV (Steve Rock, M.S.): https://wheelhouser.com/about.html#cv
- Complete LLM Technical Documentation: https://wheelhouser.com/llms-full.txt
- Flagship Digital Signage Platform: https://Marquee-Magic.com
- Enterprise Linux Package Repository (RPM & APT): https://repo.wheelhouser.com
- Location: 156 Winners Circle, Magnolia, DE
- Contact: steve.rock@wheelhouser.com | +1-302-506-2442

- [Home](https://wheelhouser.com/): Flagship Marquee-Magic showcase, Core Workstation Suite, Custom Desktop App Engineering, and Founder Steve Rock executive profile.

- [About Wheelhouser LLC & Steve Rock Executive CV](https://wheelhouser.com/about.html): Company manifesto and printable Curriculum Vitae for Founder & Principal Systems Architect Steve Rock (U.S. Air Force War on Terror Veteran, M.S. Optical Physics & NASA Space Grant Scholar, former Global PM of Industrial IoT at Xylem, former Lead Technical PM of Strategy at Optum).

- [Privacy Policy](https://wheelhouser.com/privacy.html): Ironclad privacy guarantee: Wheelhouser never tracks users, never uses or sells customer data, and never pushes ads.

## Flagship Commercial Platform

- [Marquee-Magic Digital Signage Platform](https://Marquee-Magic.com): Self-owned 4K/60fps commercial digital signage ecosystem with Designer Studio, portable & wall display players, and zero recurring SaaS lock-in.

## Forefront Core Workstation Suite (Windows, macOS & Linux)

- [Wheelhouser Web Browser](https://wheelhouser.com/products/web-browser.html): Privacy-focused QtWebEngine/Chromium desktop web browser featuring Wheelhouser Dark Mode, real-time seekable media stream transcoding, ad/tracker blocking, and unified local directory exploration.
- [Wheelhouser File Browser](https://wheelhouser.com/products/file-browser.html): High-velocity dark-mode desktop file manager with dual-pane navigation, embedded directory-synchronized dual PTY terminals, and instant code/media previews.
- [Wheelhouser Text Editor](https://wheelhouser.com/products/text-editor.html): Native cross-platform desktop code and text editor with multi-cursor editing, persistent code folding, regex search, spell check, and syntax highlighting across 15+ languages.
- [Wheelhouser Terminal](https://wheelhouser.com/products/terminal.html): Hardware-accelerated multi-tab desktop terminal emulator with built-in POSIX/Unix utilities natively on Windows (SSH, SCP, Rsync, grep, awk, sed, curl), 24-bit TrueColor themes, and local WAI command assistance.

## Developer Ecosystem & System Automation

- [Google Antigravity IDE Linux Packaging](https://wheelhouser.com/products/antigravity-ide.html): Official Linux enterprise RPM & DEB packaging, XDG desktop launcher integration, and single-instance daemon management for Google Antigravity IDE on Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
- [Wheelhouser Git Tools](https://wheelhouser.com/products/git-tools.html): Cross-platform Git automation suite featuring smart push/pull autostash workflows, interactive TUI repository fleet dashboard (`git-tools dashboard`), safe soft-reset commit undo (`undo`), and pre-commit secret scanning (`git-tools scan-secrets`).
- [Wheelhouser Auto-Updates](https://wheelhouser.com/products/auto-updates.html): Turnkey automated Linux package maintenance (`auto-updates`), zero-day CVE security patching, compiler-aware reboot protection (`gcc`, `cargo`, `make`, `rpmbuild`), and unified CLI across DNF and APT distributions.
- [Rocky Linux Setup](https://wheelhouser.com/products/rocky-linux-setup.html): Automated Enterprise Linux 10 workstation provisioning, CRB and EPEL 10 repository coordinator, developer toolchain deployment, and unattended Kickstart automation.
- [Wheelhouser Create Icon Files](https://wheelhouser.com/products/create-icon-files.html): One-click cross-platform application icon generator producing Freedesktop Hicolor PNG/SVG trees, Windows `.ico`, and macOS `.icns` bundles.

## Visual Intelligence, Audio & Productivity (On-Device AI)

- [Wheelhouser Image Background Remover](https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-background-remover.html): 100% offline, on-device AI subject isolation and batch background removal powered by RemBG for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [Wheelhouser Image Inpainter](https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-inpainter.html): Local neural network photo object and blemish eraser powered by on-device LaMa AI for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [Wheelhouser Image Resizer](https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-resizer.html): High-speed batch image resizer, aspect-ratio cropper, and format converter (PNG, WEBP, SVG, JPG) for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [Wheelhouser Text to Speech](https://wheelhouser.com/products/text-to-speech.html): Lifelike neural voice synthesis and MP3 audio export powered by Microsoft Edge Neural TTS across Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [Wheelhouser Notez](https://wheelhouser.com/products/notez.html): Fast, local-first Markdown note-taking desktop utility.
